description: Open-source, Notion-like AI editor for your local documents and meetings: chat with PDFs, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, write and fact-check with page citations, and take AI meeting notes transcribed on your computer. Compare documents in a table. Mac, Windows, Linux. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Ollama. A NotebookLM and Granola alternative.
summary: IncarnaMind is a free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux where you ask questions about your own documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and more) and write with AI. Every answer cites the exact page, and IncarnaMind checks that each quoted passage is really there.
